domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Company domains to search for email addresses, e.g. stripe.com. URLs are cleaned up and duplicates removed. Provide domains, company names, or both.

companies.title: Company names
companies.description: Company names to search instead of a domain, e.g. Stripe. Tomba resolves the company to its domain. Provide domains, company names, or both.

maxEmailsPerDomain.title: Max Emails Per Domain
maxEmailsPerDomain.description: Maximum number of emails to find per domain (applies to domain search)

includeCompanyInfo.title: Include Company Info
includeCompanyInfo.description: Include additional company information when available

limit.title: Results Limit
limit.description: Specifies the max number of email addresses to return

department.title: Department Filter
department.description: Get only email addresses for people working in the selected department

country.title: Country Filter
country.description: Two-letter country code to filter email addresses (e.g., 'US', 'UK', 'CA')

enrichMobile.title: Enrich with mobile phone numbers
enrichMobile.description: Also return each person's phone numbers (in emails[].phone_data). Costs extra: 5 additional credits ($0.0156) for every returned address that comes with phone data. Addresses without phone data cost nothing extra.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional URL that Tomba also POSTs each search result to. Results served from the cache are not sent again.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many Tomba requests run in parallel. There is no rate limit, so raise it for large lists.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Concurrency, retry and cache settings. The defaults work well for most runs.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request after a network error, 429 or 5xx response (exponential backoff). Failed requests are never charged.

useCache.title: Use cache
useCache.description: Reuse results from previous runs for identical requests. Cached results are free.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long cached results stay valid. 0 disables the cross-run cache.
